worldcombat.skill.morningsun.summary: Draws the clear daytime sun down onto itself: catching the morning light restores about two thirds of the health it has already lost and grants a burst of speed, while night or rain restores only a little with no boost.
worldcombat.skill.morningsun.use.0: A strong heal under clear day
worldcombat.skill.morningsun.use.1: Trade the heal for a speed boost
worldcombat.skill.morningsun.description: Restores %1$s of the health already lost: close to 2/3 under a clear day, only the base amount at night or in rain; more with higher Special Attack. Cannot be used at full health.
Settles after %1$s of greeting; catching the morning light also grants %2$s of increased movement speed, otherwise none.
worldcombat.skill.morningsun.timing: A self move; after %1$s s of greeting it spends %3$s PP, recovers for %2$s s with a %4$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.morningsun.growth.0: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.morningsun.growth.1: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens further to %2$s s.
Below this health ratio the companion schedules Morning Sun; lower endures longer, higher greets the light at the first wound.
On: only cast in strong sunlight, holding the move at night or in rain (little heal, no boost). Off: cast whenever wounded and accept the floor heal.
